About

I started as a reporter in 2013 and grew into a foreign affairs editor, leading coverage and teams of reporters and translators at a major national news gate. In parallel, I report and write features and interviews for Egypt Today, one of Egypt's leading English-language magazines.

Newsrooms taught me speed, accuracy and how to find the human angle. Since 2022 I have taken those skills into filmmaking, scriptwriting, voice-over and video production. Writing well is not the same as writing beautifully. I aim for both, in whichever language and format the story needs.

Zakeia: "Forever"

Campaign concept for a slow fashion brand

Zakeia makes one-of-one pieces from leftover and upcycled fabric. Nothing is restocked: when a fabric runs out, that design never exists again. Most slow fashion sells guilt relief. I built the campaign on what is literally true about Zakeia: scarcity, singularity and rebirth.

Some things cannot be restocked.
Live, forever.

The idea. Wearing Zakeia means continuing a life that was headed for an ending. The fabric did not die, it got a second story, and the wearer is the only person who will ever own that exact piece. Each film moves through one emotional arc: ending, quiet transformation, new life, memory, forever. The tone stays in calm relief, never solemn and never corporate.

The palette. Warm and non-vibrant. Every frame pairs a warm skin or light tone with an earth tone.

Warm Ivory #F1E9DD Clay Terracotta #B9714A Deep Olive #5C5C40

The campaign. A five-video narrative campaign with bilingual two-column AV scripts and a five-board visual mood deck (color, texture, human moments, light and setting, typography). The camera language favors macro textures such as frayed edges, raw seams and hands fastening buttons, with natural light and a soft analog score.

Video 1: a 60-second introduction. Quick glimpses of life, including a birth, two hands held, children playing and a walk down the street, over warm, real sounds: laughter, paper folding, cloth lifting in the air. The voice-over builds one line at a time:

  • Forever young
  • Forever happy
  • Forever exploring
  • Forever traveling
  • Forever smiling
  • Forever crying
  • Forever giving
  • Forever taking
  • Forever loving
  • Forever living

The two-line call to action then appears on screen.

Concept campaign: Healthy Cocoa Spread

A self-initiated campaign for an imaginary healthy cocoa spread, built on the choices we make in life: three jars, one choice, and "Real choice, no matter the choice." The social content is planned around Ramadan, with a launch visual, an animated graphic and a daily reminder series. Designed in Canva.
